```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# load libraries 
library(tidyverse)

# load in cleaned data

```

# Demonstration with Swedish Perturbed Data
```{r}
path_model <- '
  # Current WB
  WB_TODAY ~ h1*PHYSICAL_HLTH_c + AGE_c + AGE_c2 + h3a*SRH_x_AGE +
             EXTRAVERSION_c + NEUROTICISM_c + EXPECT_GOOD_c +
             CONSCIENTIOUSNESS_c + FEMALE + SUBJECTIVE_INCOME_c

  # Expected WB
  WB_FIVEYRS ~ h2*PHYSICAL_HLTH_c + WB_TODAY + AGE_c + AGE_c2 + h3b*SRH_x_AGE +
               EXTRAVERSION_c + NEUROTICISM_c + EXPECT_GOOD_c +
               CONSCIENTIOUSNESS_c + FEMALE + SUBJECTIVE_INCOME_c
'

fit_path <- sem(path_model,
                data      = demo,
                estimator = "MLR",
                missing   = "ml.x")

summary(fit_path, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Hypothesis tests, unstandardized (h3)
parameterEstimates(fit_path) %>%
  filter(label %in% c("h1", "h2", "h3a", "h3b")) %>%
  select(label, lhs, rhs, est, se, z, pvalue, ci.lower, ci.upper)

# Standardized
standardizedSolution(fit_path) %>%
  filter(op == "~") %>%
  select(lhs, rhs, est.std, se, pvalue)
```
